hypothesis: For the shipped Q8VNNI GRU path, obtain the exact maximum absolute value while each newly produced GRU state or projection-GELU vector is already being written. Passing that maximum into the unchanged Q8 encoder removes its separate max scan while preserving one whole-vector dynamic scale.
treatment: Fuse absmax tracking into scalar, AVX2, and AVX512 GRU hidden-state updates, and into AVX2/AVX512 GELU projection output. Reuse the existing Q8 encoder's code-writing arithmetic with the precomputed absmax.
invariants: Activation and GRU output arithmetic remain unchanged.
The GRU reads the same old recurrent state and writes the same new-state ordering.
Q8 scale is derived from the maximum absolute value of the complete output vector, with the existing exceptional-value behavior.
The existing quantization byte encoder, rounding, scales, and code order remain unchanged.
Sequence causality, per-sequence reset behavior, output masks, and model weights remain unchanged.
explicit_exclusions: No projection precompute or projection accumulation changes.
No PGO, loop reordering, fast-math, FMA reassociation, or quantization changes.
No source-model, weights, target, training, or submission-selection changes.

frozen_comparison.purpose: Exact-package CPU serving runtime and deterministic-output check only. This does not compute a model score or provide submission-selection evidence.
frozen_comparison.bitwise_gate: Each candidate panel must match all baseline per-sequence prediction hashes and its own two reset replays.
frozen_comparison.performance_gate: Require a repeatable runtime improvement in both alternating paired comparisons; otherwise retain as a negative/no-promotion result and stop this treatment.
frozen_comparison.hardware_limit: Local result is on Intel Core i9-11900H and cannot certify AMD EPYC 9224 portal runtime.
